title: claim/preview gas scales with (strategies x authorized-clients); above the discount-vs-gas threshold the permissionless consolidation stalls (owner/OOS-bounded, NOT a permissionless DoS)
description: claim() loops all registered strategies (L464) calling skimSurplus once each. Previews additionally nest _getYieldForStrategy's clients[] loop (L556, over strategy.getAuthorizedClients()) inside the strategy loop (calculateClaimAmount L659, getTotalYield L740). As strategy count and per-strategy authorized-client count grow, the gas to claim — and to fetch the quote that sets minRewardTokenSupplied — rises; if total gas exceeds discount*pending-yield, no rational claimer claims. econ-scanner CORRECTED the static/pattern premise: BOTH growable dimensions are owner-gated (addYieldStrategy is onlyOwner) and strategy-owner-gated (IYieldStrategy.setClient is owner-gated), so NO external party can force the stall — it is an operational footgun, not a permissionless griefing vector.
impact: No value loss. Operational impairment only: above a gas-vs-incentive threshold the permissionless consolidation stops being profitable, so strategy surplus accrues unconsolidated and phlimbo stops receiving rewards; preview (calculateClaimAmount/getTotalYield) can also revert on gas for an oversized client set, denying claimers the quote they use to size minRewardTokenSupplied (a claimer can still claim with min=0). Self-correcting: owner raises discount or prunes strategies; exemptStrategies (story-024) mitigates single-strategy pathologies.
attackPath: 0. No permissionless trigger: claim loops registered strategies (L464, addYieldStrategy is onlyOwner) and previews nest the clients[] loop (L556, over getAuthorizedClients(); IYieldStrategy.setClient is owner-gated). econ-scanner CORRECTED the static/pattern 'anyone depositing grows the set' premise — both growable dimensions are owner / strategy-owner authorized.
1. Owner registers many strategies and/or strategy owners authorize many clients (benign growth).
2. claim gas (and preview gas) silently rises above discount*pending-yield.

3. No rational claimer claims; consolidation stalls until the owner raises the discount or prunes strategies. A claimer can route around ONE pathological strategy via exemptStrategies (story-024) but cannot fix aggregate cardinality.
recommendation: Document a safe-config bound on (strategy count x typical client count) vs the chosen discount; consider pagination / batched claim over a strategy subrange; keep the discount tunable to track gas. exemptStrategies already mitigates single-strategy pathologies. Point owner guidance at testing claim gas against the live strategy/client cardinality before relying on permissionless consolidation.
verification: Static reasoning + interface review (IYieldStrategy.setClient owner-gated confirmed; addYieldStrategy onlyOwner). No machine PoC. econ-scanner authoritatively refuted the static/pattern permissionless-DoS premise (both growable dimensions owner/strategy-owner gated). Root cause is SYA's OWN loop over strategies/clients (in-scope), so KI#7 (external strategy behavior OOS) does not cover it.

poc.note: Low / operational; no permissionless trigger and self-correcting. Verified by static + interface reasoning.
